letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I still remember the sparkle in your eyes on that February day, and each moment since has been a sweet adventure. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, your love my safe harbor. No distance can dim the glow you bring to my heart—today, tomorrow, and all the seasons to come.
poem:
In desert dunes or mango trees we roam,  
Your smile turns every place into home.  
With you, each sunrise feels brand new,  
My love, my life, forever you.
